The test fails because `mean()` divides by one less than the number of values. In `app/calc.py`, the fix is:

```diff
-    return sum(values) / (len(values) - 1)
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
```

`app/calc.py` is read-only in this workspace, so I couldn’t apply the fix there. I verified it in a writable copy: `python -m pytest -q` reported `1 passed`.
